edges.reason: auth modifier gates the entire body on isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig)
setOwner is auth protected so msg.sender must be owner or pass authority.canCall
setAuthority is auth protected and can swap the whole authority contract
changeOwner requires admin == msg.sender before transferring ownership
changeAdmin requires admin == msg.sender before replacing the admin
kill is restricted by onlyAdmin which reads adminVault.admin()
withdrawStuckFunds is restricted by onlyOwner which reads adminVault.owner()
changeAdminVault is restricted by onlyAdmin
createStrategy binds the new strategy to msg.sender as its proxy owner
updateStrategy requires msg.sender == s.proxy
removeStrategy requires msg.sender == s.proxy
onlyOwner reads the owner field from the configurable adminVault state variable
onlyAdmin reads the admin field from the configurable adminVault state variable
changeAdminVault is gated by onlyAdmin reading adminVault.admin()
isAuthorized compares src against the stored owner state variable
isAuthorized delegates to authority.canCall when owner check fails
withdrawStuckFunds performs an ETH transfer when the token is the ETH sentinel
ERC20 branch routes the transfer through SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn
SafeERC20 optional return helper ultimately performs an arbitrary low-level call
Address.sendValue forwards ETH with a low-level call to an arbitrary recipient
kill executes selfdestruct forwarding the balance to msg.sender
executeTask is wrapped by the burnGas modifier
burnGas calls gasToken.free/chiToken.free with a gas amount derived from msg.data.length
gasToken balance and gasTokenAmount decide whether free() is invoked
chiToken balance is used as the fallback refund path for free()
executeTask delegates all execution to _executeActions
executeStrategyTask builds a Task from stored data and calls _executeActions
executeStrategyTask resolves the Subscriptions address via registry.getAddr
executeStrategyTask reads strategy and template storage from the Subscriptions contract
the non-FL path loops over action ids calling _executeAction
the FL path dispatches to _parseFLAndExecute
isFL is consulted on the first action address to detect flash loan actions
_parseFLAndExecute grants DSProxy execute permission to the FL action before calling it
the FL action is executed through _executeAction after injecting taskData
_parseFLAndExecute revokes the granted permission after the FL execution returns
givePermission reads DSAuth.authority and replaces it with a new guard when empty
givePermission uses the hardcoded factory address to create a new guard
removePermission reads the current authority and forbids the permission on it
_executeAction forwards the action call through IDSProxy.execute with the full contract balance
_executeAction resolves each action address through registry.getAddr
the flash loan provider invokes the public _executeActionsFromFL callback which continues task execution
the external proxy call re-enters the executor context and further actions run without a reentrancy guard
the callback skips the first action and executes the remaining actions based on callback-supplied values
createStrategy pushes a new Strategy entry into the strategies array
createStrategy increments updateCounter
createStrategy records the new index in usersPos for msg.sender
updateStrategy mutates the stored Strategy fields in storage
removeStrategy moves the last strategy into the deleted slot and pops the array
removeStrategy removes the strategy index from the owner usersPos array
removeStrategy computes the last array index from strategies.length
addNewContract writes a new Entry into the entries mapping
startContractChange stores block.timestamp as changeStartTime for the timelock
approveContractChange compares block.timestamp against changeStartTime plus waitPeriod
approveContractChange promotes the pending address into the entries mapping
previousAddresses supplies the fallback address used when reverting an entry
approveContractChange stores the old contract address into previousAddresses

normalization_plan.reason: _currTask is the Task parameter of executeTask and carries no independent identity
_strategyId is only used by executeStrategyTask to look up stored strategy data
_owner is the sole parameter of AdminVault.changeOwner
_admin is the sole parameter of AdminVault.changeAdmin
_token selects the withdrawal branch inside withdrawStuckFunds
_receiver is the transfer destination used only in withdrawStuckFunds
_amount is only meaningful as the value moved by withdrawStuckFunds
_newAdminVault is the only parameter of changeAdminVault
_contractAddr identifies the contract authorized by ProxyPermission.givePermission
_flAmount is consumed by the _executeActionsFromFL callback as the first return value
currAuthority is a temporary read of DSAuth.authority inside givePermission
returnValues is the internal accumulator built and consumed by _executeActions
taskData is a transient encoding constructed inside _parseFLAndExecute
gasTokenAmount is a transient value feeding the gasToken.free unsafe external call
firstActionAddr is a temporary resolved address tested by _executeActions
lastSub is a temporary index computed inside removeStrategy
